tools.title: 查看 AI 插件
tools.description: List AI plugins in the current App. Use the returned plugin_id rather than guessing an ID. Credential values are returned as __MASKED_SENSITIVE_VALUE__; the marker is not the real value.

tools.title: 查看插件函数
tools.description: List FunctionCall definitions belonging to one plugin with inclusive start and end indexes.

start.description: Optional zero-based first result index; defaults to 0.

end.description: Optional inclusive last result index; defaults to 20.

tools.title: 创建 AI 插件
tools.description: Create an empty AI plugin. Functions and Agent bindings are separate operations.

tools.title: 修改 AI 插件
tools.description: Partially update plugin configuration. Omitted top-level fields remain unchanged. In headers, params, envs, or auth, submitting a returned __MASKED_SENSITIVE_VALUE__ value preserves the existing value at that exact path; another value replaces it; an empty string clears it. Never invent, display, or repeat a credential.

name.description: Plugin display name; empty string is not valid.

endpoint.description: Public HTTPS callback base URL; empty string clears it. Private, loopback and local addresses are rejected.

headers.description: Complete HTTP header configuration. Returned sensitive values use __MASKED_SENSITIVE_VALUE__; submit that exact marker to preserve an existing value. Omitting a key from a submitted headers object removes that key.

params.description: Complete callback query parameter configuration with the same masked-value semantics as headers.

envs.description: Complete plugin environment-variable configuration. Preserve returned masked values unless the user explicitly supplies a replacement.

auth.description: Complete authentication configuration. The type remains visible; usernames and passwords may be masked. Preserve markers unless the user explicitly supplies replacements.

tools.title: 修改插件函数
tools.description: Partially update non-secret FunctionCall metadata or its JSON parameter schema. Read the function first and send only requested fields.

name.description: Function name exposed to the model.

description.description: Clear description of when and how to call the function.

parameters.description: Complete JSON Schema for function arguments.

force_call.description: Whether the function is forced for matching messages.

tools.title: 查看插件知识配置
tools.description: Read the shared knowledge retrieval model and limits used by AI plugins.

tools.title: 修改插件知识配置
tools.description: Partially update plugin knowledge retrieval limits or embedding model; omitted fields remain unchanged.

embedding_max_tokens.description: Maximum retrieved knowledge tokens, greater than zero.

embedding_max_blocks.description: Maximum retrieved blocks, greater than zero.
